name: midwrite-fixture-phase16-retry
description: Midwrite Phase 16 first-party application: retry loops written as `for`/`while` loops around database writes (an insert repeated after an ambiguous COMMIT, and its idempotent counterpart keyed by a reused idempotency key), a SERIALIZABLE transaction retried on SQLSTATE 40001, and a route handler reading `await request.json()` and answering `Response.json(...)`. Drizzle ORM on node-postgres.
